name: Daikokuya Koudayu
source:
A Zipangu girl cast away to Russia. She seems to be receiving good treatment.

A hero who served the former Russian emperor, Rurik. Although she is Zipangu, she has the typical Russian masochistic tendencies.

"What a powerful embrace...!"
